description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, managing initialization, navigation setup, notification permission checking, and scheduling notifications.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class responsible for initializing the app, setting up navigation, and handling notifications and analytics.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Entry point for activity creation, sets layout, and calls setup functions.

methods.name: setupNavigation
methods.description: Initializes navigation fragment and sets up listener for destination changes to log screen views.

methods.name: checkNotificationPermission
methods.description: Checks shared preferences and prompts for notification permissions if enabled.

methods.name: scheduleNotifications
methods.description: Schedules notifications if enabled in shared preferences.
